values.summary: Implemented a general direct Z.ai GLM-5.3-Flash provider profile with bounded runtime overrides and reviewer-agent selection proof.
actual_changes: Added `z_ai:glm-5.3-flash` as a first-class provider profile resolving to `hosted:adl-z-ai:glm-5.3-flash` and provider model id `glm-5.3-flash`.
Updated the canonical Z.ai direct chat-completions endpoint to `https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4/chat/completions`.
Materialized GLM-5.3-Flash defaults for `reasoning_effort=max`, `clear_thinking=false`, `temperature=1.0`, `top_p=0.95`, and bounded output tokens.
Added runtime adapter support for GLM-5.3-Flash request parameters and fail-closed validation for invalid overrides before network dispatch.
Added reviewer-selection and HTTP request-materialization tests.
Documented the direct profile, source rationale, provider-variant boundaries, and the bind/prepared-helper materialization tooling issue.

actual_validation.purpose: Prove the general Z.ai GLM-5.3-Flash profile expands deterministically, can be selected by a reviewer agent, materializes documented request parameters, rejects invalid runtime overrides before dispatch, and preserves the existing provider test target.
